Container.Name: incipit-redis
Container.Overview:
SET NETWORK FIRST. All three containers must share the SAME user-defined docker network, or container-name DNS does not resolve and the API exits at boot reporting MONGODB_URI. Unraid's default "bridge" does NOT resolve names.
Redis for incipit-api. Caches provider search results (which is what keeps the stack inside Hardcover's 60 req/min limit) and audnexus responses, and it is where alternate cover art is stored between a search and a later item lookup.
OPTIONAL but strongly recommended: without REDIS_URL the API still runs, but every book lookup that needs alternate covers would re-run a full provider search on every request, so that feature disables itself instead.
Publishes NO port: only incipit-api talks to it over your chosen network. Start this BEFORE incipit-api.
Container.Requires: All three containers on the SAME user-defined docker network, so container-name DNS resolves. Unraid's default "bridge" does NOT resolve names.

Config.Name: Cache storage
Config.Description: Redis append-only/snapshot directory. Losing it costs only cache warmth, never data.
